speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng
text: asked	the Minister for National Development whether NParks will consider providing (i) free parking at its facilities for the public for the first two hours and at off-peak times; and (ii) free parking for residents holding a season HDB parking label within a reasonable vicinity and, if not, a concessionary parking rate for such residents.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Our parks are also well-linked by the extensive park connector network and are served by public transport.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Aligned with Singapore's car-lite vision, we encourage Singaporeans to walk, cycle or take public transport to our parks.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: For those who need to drive, parking spaces are provided but these are limited.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: These car park lots are charged to regulate usage and to ensure availability of lots for park users.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: This is to benefit early morning park users, many of whom are seniors and retirees.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: In fact, for those staying near a park, we would want to encourage them to leave their cars at the HDB parking lots and walk or cycle to the park.

speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
text: If I may ask just one supplementary question, which has been very much on the minds of my Clementi residents who are affected by the change in policy.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: And at times, park users were unable to find a car lot due to high demand and low turnover because people were not leaving.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: NParks also received feedback over many years that some non-park users, such as weekend car owners, second-hand and rental car dealers, goods vehicle owners and vehicles belonging to residents living nearby, have been parking at these free car parks and, therefore, depriving genuine park users who need to drive from parking space.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: It takes time and enforcement effort and there is a need to investigate circumstances.
